facts.business: HPL Electric & Power Limited operates as a two-engine electrical platform comprising Metering, Systems & Services and Consumer, Industrial & Services segments.
key_risks: Tax litigations with significant judgement involved in assessment of outcomes
Economic fluctuations influencing demand and supply dynamics and pricing
Modifications in governmental regulations and policies, taxation norms
Availability and cost of raw materials
facts.related_party_note: Transactions with related parties include purchase/sale of goods and services, purchase of assets, dividend payments, and managerial remuneration with entities such as Himachal Energy Private Limited, HPL India Limited, HPL Electronics Private Limited, HPL Holdings Private Limited, and key management personnel and their relatives.
